name: Aunt Granny's Restaurant
description: A Dollywood favourite since 1986 in Rivertown Junction, serving Southern dishes as an all-you-care-to-eat buffet. Expect comfort food such as chicken and dumplings, corn pudding and Stone Soup. The menu changes over time, so ask on arrival what is on offer today.

items.name: All-You-Care-To-Eat Buffet
items.description: Southern buffet with changing hot dishes such as chicken and dumplings and corn pudding, plus sides and desserts

name: Hickory House BBQ
description: A table-service smokehouse in Craftsman's Valley serving award-winning BBQ recipes. The menu centres on pulled pork, BBQ sandwiches and cheesesteak sandwiches, a hearty stop for hungry families between rides.

items.name: Pulled Pork Sandwich
items.description: Slow-cooked pulled pork in BBQ sauce on a bun

items.name: BBQ Cheesesteak Sandwich
items.description: Sliced beef and cheese on a toasted roll with BBQ sauce

name: Granny Ogle's Ham 'n' Beans
description: A Craftsman's Valley restaurant known for its ham and pinto beans, served in generous portions. A simple, filling Southern classic that fits the park's Appalachian setting.

items.name: Ham 'n' Beans
items.description: Ham and pinto beans served in a generous portion

name: Cinnamon Bread at The Grist Mill
description: Dollywood's signature treat: cinnamon bread baked fresh daily at The Grist Mill in Craftsman's Valley. The mill was built in 1982 and was described as Tennessee's first fully working grist mill in over 100 years. The bread comes plain, with icing or with apple butter.

items.name: Cinnamon Bread with Icing
items.description: Cinnamon bread topped with sweet icing

items.name: Cinnamon Bread with Apple Butter
items.description: Cinnamon bread served with apple butter
